name: wikipedia-skill
description: Gives a short encyclopedia summary about a person, place, thing, or topic using Wikipedia.

intents.description: Ask for a background summary or encyclopedia-style overview of a person, place, event, or topic — 'tell me about', 'who is', 'what is'.
example_utterances: Give me a summary of the Taj Mahal
What is the Great Wall of China?
Tell me about the solar system
